missionPremise: Cards are claimed against a queue that refuses. Source: _decisions/2026-09-01_seat_queue_protocol.md and _dispatches/2026-09-01_queue-init_dispatch.md. A passing self-test is the planner checking the planner and is not evidence.
completionPredicate: Five constructed violations observed to refuse or release as specified (WRONG_SEAT, STORE_TOKEN_HELD, MAINTENANCE_WINDOW, ALREADY_CLAIMED, expired lease returns claimable). Bypass paths named. Close names what contradicted the card. Board then taken by the property seat loop, one card at a time.
scopeBasis: doc_repo queue files and CLI only. No Factory image rebuild. No product-repo write during the break pass. factory-merges is the first real card and is claimed by the loop after this close, not during the break pass.

design.store_token_held: write a constructed cortex-prod token held by a dummy card, then claim ctx-totals; remove the token after
design.maintenance_window: claim ctx-totals now; Tuesday 05:00-06:00 UTC is live, so no temporary window
design.already_claimed: claim factory-merges as property, claim again, release with verification reason
design.lease_expire: write claim.json with expires_at in the past, confirm status shows CLAIMABLE, confirm a real claim then succeeds, release
design.falsifier: any of the five grants, or an expired lease that stays stuck, fails this card
